title: 保育園の毎日素材
subject: 保育園の毎日素材
subject_en: A Japanese woman nursery teacher in her 30s with short brown hair, yellow apron, white shirt, beige pants, and small children in colorful simple clothes, picture-book style with soft rounded outlines and warm pastel colors, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
lead: 保育園の一日を、絵本風の温かいタッチで表す素材です。園だより、子育て支援、保育サービス、入園案内の説明に使いやすいです。検索結果でも用途が伝わりやすいです。
